description: Searches Haulest's written guides, calculators, and checklists about hiring movers, estimates, deposits, consumer rights (US interstate rules, UK and Canadian practice), packing, and timing. Returns each match's title, one-paragraph answer, and URL. Use it for how-to and what-does-this-mean questions about moving.

limit.description: How many results, up to 8 (larger values return 8). Default 5.

query.description: What the person wants to know, e.g. "binding estimate", "tipping movers", "deposit", "damage claim", "when to book".

name: search_moving_guides
title: Search Haulest guides
